name: Chemical Engineering
tagline: Reactor design, process optimization, and chemical plant operations.
seo_title: Chemical Engineering — paper summaries, news & innovations | Chemisters
seo_description: Follow Chemisters Chemical Engineering on LinkedIn and Facebook: paper summaries, news and innovations in reactor design, separations, process safety, scale-up and process control.

definition.lead: Chemical engineering designs and runs the processes that turn raw materials into useful products, at scales of tonnes per hour.
definition.body: It combines chemistry with mass and energy balances, fluid flow, heat transfer, separations, reaction engineering and control. Chemical engineers scale up drugs, fuels, food, water treatment and batteries, and keep plants safe and efficient.

timeline.title: A new degree
timeline.text: MIT starts the first chemical engineering degree, Course X.

timeline.title: The first handbook
timeline.text: George E. Davis publishes 'A Handbook of Chemical Engineering'.
timeline.why: Organized the field's knowledge for practitioners.

timeline.title: AIChE
timeline.text: The American Institute of Chemical Engineers is founded.
timeline.why: Gave the profession a home and standards.

timeline.title: Unit operations
timeline.text: Arthur D. Little describes processes as combinations of standard operations.
timeline.why: The way chemical engineering is still taught.

timeline.title: A founding textbook
timeline.text: Walker, Lewis and McAdams publish 'Principles of Chemical Engineering'.

timeline.title: Penicillin at scale
timeline.text: Pfizer opens a deep-tank fermentation plant for penicillin.
timeline.why: Engineering turned a lab curiosity into a mass-produced drug.

timeline.title: Transport Phenomena
timeline.text: Bird, Stewart and Lightfoot publish their textbook.
timeline.why: Unified the treatment of heat, mass and momentum transfer.

timeline.title: Flixborough
timeline.text: An explosion at a chemical plant in Flixborough, England, kills 28 people.
timeline.why: Reshaped process safety thinking and regulation.

timeline.title: Process simulation
timeline.text: AspenTech is founded to commercialize the ASPEN process simulator developed at MIT.
timeline.why: Computer simulation became standard in plant design.

quiz.q: Which 1974 accident in England reshaped process safety?
options: Flixborough
Chernobyl
Exxon Valdez
Seveso
quiz.explain: A temporary pipe failed, releasing cyclohexane that exploded.

quiz.q: In a plug-flow reactor, composition changes…
options: Along the length of the tube
Uniformly over time
Randomly
Not at all
quiz.explain: Each slice of fluid behaves like a small batch reactor moving down the tube.

quiz.q: When was the American Institute of Chemical Engineers founded?
